parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance) as att_total,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance WHERE status='present') as att_present,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance WHERE status='absent') as att_absent,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance WHERE status='late') as att_late,(SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='present')*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) FROM attendance) as att_rate,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_submissions) as sub_total,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_submissions WHERE status='on_time') as sub_on_time,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_submissions WHERE is_late=TRUE) as sub_late,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_submissions WHERE status='missing') as sub_missing,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feedback WHERE grade IS NOT NULL) as fb_total,(SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(grade),1),0) FROM feedback WHERE grade IS NOT NULL) as fb_avg,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feedback WHERE grade >= 60) as fb_passing,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feedback WHERE grade < 60) as fb_failing,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM error_logs) as err_total,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports) as rpt_total,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications_log) as notif_total
SELECT workflow_name, node_name, LEFT(error_message,120) as error_message, TO_CHAR(created_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as created_at FROM error_logs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT student_id, student_name, task_id, task_name, status, is_late, TO_CHAR(COALESCE(submission_date, created_at),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as fecha FROM task_submissions ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 8
